head.text: WF-010 Variable-latency read with RWDS HIGH in the CA phase (2x latency)

signal: HyperBus read (abstract, one slot = one CK period)

foot.text: RWDS HIGH during the CA phase doubles the initial latency in variable mode (hr_dN_cfg.fixed_lat = 0); fixed mode always waits 2 x init_lat. Illustrative timing, init_lat shortened.
